name: accessibility
description: The automation properties of an element, apart from its name; they need the Automation.Peers types.

AutomationId.comment: What a test or a reader's script finds the element by -- AutomationProperties.AutomationId, the attached property.

AutomationAccessibilityView.comment: Which view of the automation tree the element is in -- Raw for a picture that says nothing a screen reader should read: AutomationProperties.AccessibilityView, the attached property.

AutomationLiveSetting.comment: That a change of the element's text is announced by a screen reader, politely or at once -- AutomationProperties.LiveSetting, the attached property.

AutomationHeadingLevel.comment: That the element is a heading, and of which level -- AutomationProperties.HeadingLevel, the attached property.

AutomationLandmarkType.comment: The landmark of the page the element is -- navigation, main, search -- AutomationProperties.LandmarkType, the attached property.

AutomationControlType.comment: What kind of control a screen reader takes the element for -- AutomationProperties.AutomationControlType, the attached property.

AutomationLocalizedControlType.comment: What a screen reader calls that kind of control in the user's language -- AutomationProperties.LocalizedControlType, the attached property.

AutomationLocalizedLandmarkType.comment: What a screen reader calls the landmark in the user's language -- AutomationProperties.LocalizedLandmarkType, the attached property.

AutomationAcceleratorKey.comment: The shortcut that does what the element does, as a screen reader says it -- AutomationProperties.AcceleratorKey, the attached property.

AutomationHelpText.comment: A few words of help, spoken after the name -- AutomationProperties.HelpText, the attached property.

AutomationFullDescription.comment: The long description of the element -- AutomationProperties.FullDescription, the attached property.

AutomationPositionInSet.comment: The place of the element among its siblings, 1-based -- AutomationProperties.PositionInSet, the attached property.

AutomationSizeOfSet.comment: How many siblings the element has with itself -- AutomationProperties.SizeOfSet, the attached property.

AutomationLabeledBy.comment: The element whose text names this one -- AutomationProperties.LabeledBy, the attached property.
